name: Boquiñeni (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a red central panel edged by blue wavy pales, charged with a yellow boat bearing the letter B.
history: Municipal flag of Boquiñeni; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
